subject: Classwork before Friday
text:
Hi,

As your classmate, I reviewed the classwork notes for this new client request. Because your deadline is Friday, we should focus only on the outline and the two required readings. I will send my annotated bibliography tonight. Please confirm whether you want citations in APA or MLA. I can finish the first draft if you send the rubric by noon.

Let me know which sections you want handled first. This keeps us inside the tight deadline without losing points.

Best regards,
